title: Starting Rate for Home Comfort Financing Payoff Per-Diem Interest
content:
**Rule.** The payoff per-diem rate on a Home Comfort Financing account starts from the rate the balance is accruing at:

- the plan's post-promotional APR when the plan has a promotional period and the promotional end date has passed;
- the plan's APR less the plan's autopay APR reduction when no promotional period has ended, autopay is enrolled and no payment was returned less than 12 whole months before the day of payoff;
- the plan's APR less 50 percent of the plan's autopay APR reduction when no promotional period has ended, autopay is enrolled and exactly one payment was returned in that time;
- and the plan's APR in every other case.

The tests are read in that order; the first that holds sets the starting rate.

## Decision table

| Promotional period ended before the day of payoff | Autopay enrolled | Payments returned in the last 12 whole months | Starting rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | the plan's post-promotional APR |
| no (or the plan has none) | yes | none | the plan's APR less the full autopay APR reduction |
| no (or the plan has none) | yes | exactly one | the plan's APR less 50 percent of the autopay APR reduction |
| no (or the plan has none) | yes | two or more | the plan's APR |
| no (or the plan has none) | no | any | the plan's APR |

Autopay enrollment is read from the account record on the day of payoff; returned payments are the returned-payment entries posted on the account less than 12 whole months before the day of payoff.

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Account | Starting rate |
|---|---|
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan (autopay reduction 0.25 points), autopay enrolled, no returns | 5.99 less 0.25: 5.74 percent |
| same, one return in the last 12 whole months | 5.99 less 50 percent of 0.25 (0.125): 5.865 percent |
| same, two returns | 5.99 percent |
| same, autopay not enrolled | 5.99 percent |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan, promotional end date passed | 17.99 percent |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan still within its promotion, autopay enrolled, no returns | 0.00 less 0.00: 0.00 percent |

The starting rate is not rounded.
